dek: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming quietly returned to the Seed AI research team two weeks ago and laid down a no-distillation mandate. The mid-year All-Hands followed with a major B-side structure change that puts Doubao, Feishu and Volcano Engine under one product roof.
